question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Please ______ my subscription of the children’s magazine.
solution:
The correct answer is '**renew**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**renew**'.
 
• **'Subscription renewal'** is the process each customer goes through when continuing their subscription into the next billing cycle. 
 
 
• *Example: Academic institutions tend to **renew their subscriptions** at the start of the scholastic year. *
 
 
 
• All the other words in the given Options are incorrect.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *Please **renew** my subscription of the children's magazine.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Settle**: to put an end to an argument or disagreement. (बहस या विवाद को सुलझा लेना)
 
• **Finish**: to complete something or reach the end of something. (किसी काम को पूरा या समाप्‍त करना)
 
• **Regain**: to get something back that you had lost. (खोयी हुई चीज़ को पुनः प्राप्‍त करना)
